pattern: From my perspective / The main reason / underlying reason
note: 高分口语的观点不是堆连接词，而是立场清楚、合理限定，并能解释机制。
ielts: 重点训练 Part 3 的立场与理由展开。
mistake: 高级词不能替代理由；每个观点后要解释 why/how。

slots.x: From my perspective, convenience matters more than variety in everyday services.
slots.z: 从我的角度看，日常服务中便利比多样性更重要。
slots.alt: The way I see it, convenience usually matters more.

slots.x: I tend to think the benefits outweigh the drawbacks.
slots.z: 我倾向认为利大于弊。
slots.alt: On balance, I think the advantages are greater.

slots.x: The policy makes sense in principle, but its impact depends on implementation.
slots.z: 这个政策原则上合理，但影响取决于实施。
slots.alt: In principle it makes sense, though implementation is crucial.

slots.x: The main reason is that it saves people time.
slots.z: 主要原因是它能节省时间。
slots.alt: The key reason is the time it saves.

slots.x: That happens largely because people's schedules are less predictable.
slots.z: 这很大程度是因为人们的日程更难预测。
slots.alt: A major factor is less predictable schedules.

slots.x: One underlying reason is that the incentives reward short-term results.
slots.z: 一个深层原因是激励机制奖励短期结果。
slots.alt: The deeper issue is how the incentives are structured.

slots.x: I don't think there's a single reason; it's probably a combination of factors.
slots.z: 我不觉得只有一个原因，可能是多种因素共同作用。
slots.alt: It's likely driven by several factors.

slots.x: The strongest argument for it is that it improves access without adding much cost.
slots.z: 支持它最有力的理由是，它能提升可及性而不大幅增加成本。
slots.alt: Its strongest case is improved access at relatively low cost.

pattern: For example / Compared with / The main difference...
note: 例子必须服务观点；比较则要在同一维度上进行。
ielts: 适合 Part 2 和 Part 3 的具体化与对比。
mistake: far more 正确；不要说 more better。

slots.x: For example, people can now do most banking tasks on their phones.
slots.z: 比如现在人们可以用手机完成大多数银行业务。
slots.alt: A simple example is mobile banking.

slots.x: A good example would be public transport apps.
slots.z: 一个很好的例子是公共交通应用。
slots.alt: Take transport apps, for instance.

slots.x: To give a concrete example, flexible work can help parents stay employed.
slots.z: 举个具体例子，灵活办公可以帮助父母继续就业。
slots.alt: A concrete case is flexible work for parents.

slots.x: Compared with ten years ago, people have far more choice.
slots.z: 和十年前相比，人们现在有多得多的选择。
slots.alt: People have much more choice than they did a decade ago.

slots.x: Online services are more convenient, whereas face-to-face services feel more personal.
slots.z: 线上更方便，而面对面服务更有人情味。
slots.alt: Online is convenient; in-person service is more personal.

slots.x: I wouldn't say one is universally better; they solve different problems.
slots.z: 我不会说哪一个普遍更好，它们解决不同问题。
slots.alt: It depends on the user and the situation.

slots.x: The difference is less about quality and more about accessibility.
slots.z: 差异不太在质量，而更多在可及性。
slots.alt: Accessibility is the bigger difference.

slots.x: The younger group values speed more, while older users tend to value reliability.
slots.z: 年轻群体更重速度，而年长用户往往更重可靠性。
slots.alt: The groups prioritize different things.

pattern: There has been / have become / expectations have shifted
note: 描述变化要说方向、时间和可能原因，而不是只说 things changed a lot。
ielts: 适合科技、社会、消费、教育等常见主题。
mistake: over the past few years 常用现在完成时。

slots.x: There has been a clear shift toward online services.
slots.z: 人们明显转向了线上服务。
slots.alt: Online services have become much more common.

slots.x: People have become more comfortable with paying digitally.
slots.z: 人们对数字支付变得更接受。
slots.alt: Digital payment has become more normal.

slots.x: Expectations around speed and convenience have shifted as well.
slots.z: 人们对速度和便利的期待也变了。
slots.alt: Consumer expectations have changed too.

slots.x: The change has been gradual rather than sudden.
slots.z: 这个变化是逐渐发生的，而不是突然的。
slots.alt: It's been a gradual shift.

slots.x: The trend seems to have accelerated in the last few years.
slots.z: 这个趋势在过去几年似乎加速了。
slots.alt: The pace of change has picked up recently.

slots.x: What used to be optional is increasingly becoming the default.
slots.z: 以前可选的东西正越来越变成默认。
slots.alt: It's moving from optional to standard.

slots.x: The technology changed first, and people's habits followed.
slots.z: 先是技术变化，然后人们的习惯跟着变。
slots.alt: Behavior changed after the technology became widespread.

slots.x: The pattern is similar across many cities, although the pace differs.
slots.z: 许多城市都有类似趋势，不过速度不同。
slots.alt: The direction is similar, but the pace varies.

note: 高分优缺点不是罗列，而是说明谁受益、代价是什么、在什么条件下成立。
mistake: at the expense of = 以…为代价。

slots.x: The main advantage is that it gives people more flexibility.
slots.z: 主要优势是它给人们更多灵活性。
slots.alt: Its biggest benefit is flexibility.

slots.x: The downside is that convenience can come at the expense of human interaction.
slots.z: 缺点是便利有时会以人际互动为代价。
slots.alt: The trade-off is less face-to-face interaction.

slots.x: The benefit is real, but it isn't evenly distributed.
slots.z: 好处确实存在，但并不均匀。
slots.alt: The gains aren't shared equally.

slots.x: For some groups, the convenience is significant; for others, access is the bigger issue.
slots.z: 对一些群体便利很重要，对另一些群体可及性才是问题。
slots.alt: Different groups experience different benefits.

slots.x: The short-term gain may create a longer-term cost.
slots.z: 短期收益可能带来长期成本。
slots.alt: There may be a long-term trade-off.

slots.x: The advantage depends heavily on whether people have a real choice.
slots.z: 这个优势很大程度取决于人们是否真的有选择。
slots.alt: It only works well if people have alternatives.

slots.x: Efficiency is valuable, but it shouldn't come at the cost of fairness.
slots.z: 效率很重要，但不应以公平为代价。
slots.alt: The challenge is balancing efficiency and fairness.

slots.x: The ideal solution would preserve the benefit while reducing the downside.
slots.z: 理想方案是保留好处同时减少缺点。
slots.alt: The goal should be to keep the upside and limit the cost.

pattern: lead to / discourage / depends on / cautious about generalizing
note: 成熟分析会控制因果强度，并主动限定结论适用范围。
ielts: 适合 Part 3 社会、政策、科技类题目。
mistake: can / may / tends to 用来匹配证据强度。

slots.x: That can lead to longer waiting times.
slots.z: 这可能导致更长的等待时间。
slots.alt: That may result in longer waits.

slots.x: As a result, people may become less willing to use the service.
slots.z: 因此，人们可能更不愿使用这项服务。
slots.alt: That can discourage people from using it.

slots.x: The effect can become self-reinforcing over time.
slots.z: 这个影响可能随着时间自我强化。
slots.alt: It can turn into a feedback loop.

slots.x: It depends on the situation.
slots.z: 这取决于具体情况。
slots.alt: It really depends on the context.

slots.x: To some extent, yes, but I don't think that's the whole story.
slots.z: 某种程度上是，但我不觉得事情只有这一面。
slots.alt: Partly, yes, but there are other factors.

slots.x: I'd be cautious about making a broad generalization.
slots.z: 我会谨慎做广泛概括。
slots.alt: It's difficult to generalize across very different groups.

slots.x: The relationship is probably indirect rather than purely causal.
slots.z: 这个关系可能更偏间接，而不是纯粹因果。
slots.alt: I wouldn't assume a direct causal link.

slots.x: The outcome varies a lot by age, income and location.
slots.z: 结果会因年龄、收入和地区有很大差异。
slots.alt: The effect differs substantially across groups.

pattern: If I had / One experience that stands out / In general...
note: Part 2 需要清楚时间线，Part 3 需要合理概括；两者都不需要堆砌复杂词。
ielts: 覆盖假设、个人经历与总结。
mistake: if 从句的虚拟假设里不要用 would。

slots.x: If I had more free time, I'd probably learn another language.
slots.z: 如果我有更多空闲时间，我可能会再学一门语言。
slots.alt: With more free time, I'd learn another language.

slots.x: If public transport were cheaper, more people might use it.
slots.z: 如果公共交通更便宜，可能会有更多人使用。
slots.alt: Lower fares could encourage more regular use.

slots.x: One experience that stands out was a trip I took alone.
slots.z: 一个让我印象很深的经历是一次独自旅行。
slots.alt: A trip I took alone really stands out in my memory.

slots.x: What made it memorable wasn't the place itself, but how independent I felt.
slots.z: 真正让我难忘的不是地方，而是独立感。
slots.alt: The place mattered less than the feeling of independence.

slots.x: At first, I wasn't sure what to expect.
slots.z: 一开始我不知道会是什么样。
slots.alt: Initially, I didn't really know what to expect.

slots.x: By the end of the day, I felt completely differently about it.
slots.z: 到那天结束时，我的看法完全变了。
slots.alt: By the end, my view had changed completely.

slots.x: In general, younger people seem more comfortable with the technology.
slots.z: 总体来说，年轻人似乎更习惯这项技术。
slots.alt: Younger people tend to be more comfortable with it.

slots.x: The pattern is real, but the reasons differ from one group to another.
slots.z: 这个趋势确实存在，但原因因群体而异。
slots.alt: The trend exists, but the explanation isn't the same for everyone.
